title: Optimal skyrmion stability in antisymmetric ultrathin ferromagnetic bilayers
summary: We demonstrate the stray-field-mediated skyrmion stabilizing capabilities of ultrathin exchange-decoupled antisymmetric ferromagnetic bilayers based on conventional transition metal materials. Using an asymptotically exact micromagnetic model valid in the ultrathin film limit, we show that the antisymmetric tailoring of the bilayer allows the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction and the dipolar interaction to act synergistically to stabilize skyrmions, in contrast to the monolayer case, in which these energies compete.
